entries.text: Your metabolic rate is twice normal.  This means that you are much less resistant to radiation and poison, but your body heals faster.
entries.source_text: Your metabolic rate is twice normal.  This means that you are much less resistant to radiation and poison, but your body heals faster.

entries.text: A little slower, but a little bigger.  You may not hit as often, but they will feel it when you do!  Your total action points are lowered, but your Strength is increased.
entries.source_text: A little slower, but a little bigger.  You may not hit as often, but they will feel it when you do!  Your total action points are lowered, but your Strength is increased.

entries.text: You are not quite as big as the other Vault-Dwellers, but that never slowed you down.  You can't carry as much, but you are more agile.
entries.source_text: You are not quite as big as the other Vault-Dwellers, but that never slowed you down.  You can't carry as much, but you are more agile.

entries.text: One of your hands is very dominant.  You excel with single-handed weapons, but two-handed weapons cause a problem.
entries.source_text: One of your hands is very dominant.  You excel with single-handed weapons, but two-handed weapons cause a problem.

entries.text: Your attacks show a lot of finesse.  You don't do as much damage, but you cause more critical hits.
entries.source_text: Your attacks show a lot of finesse.  You don't do as much damage, but you cause more critical hits.

entries.text: By not paying attention to any threats, you can act a lot faster in a turn.  This lowers your armor class to just what you are wearing, but you sequence much faster in a combat turn.
entries.source_text: By not paying attention to any threats, you can act a lot faster in a turn.  This lowers your armor class to just what you are wearing, but you sequence much faster in a combat turn.

entries.text: You swing harder, not better.  Your attacks are very brutal, but lack finesse.  You rarely cause a good critical, but you always do more melee damage.
entries.source_text: You swing harder, not better.  Your attacks are very brutal, but lack finesse.  You rarely cause a good critical, but you always do more melee damage.

entries.text: You don't have time to aim for a targeted attack, because you attack faster than normal people.  It costs you one less action point to use a weapon.
entries.source_text: You don't have time to aim for a targeted attack, because you attack faster than normal people.  It costs you one less action point to use a weapon.

entries.text: By some strange twist of fate, people around you die violently.  You always see the worst way a person can die.
entries.source_text: By some strange twist of fate, people around you die violently.  You always see the worst way a person can die.

entries.text: The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat, the bad thing is so do you!
entries.source_text: The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat, the bad thing is so do you!

entries.text: You studied less-combative skills as you were growing up.  Your combat skills start at a lower level, but First Aid, Doctor, Speech and Barter are substantially improved.
entries.source_text: You studied less-combative skills as you were growing up.  Your combat skills start at a lower level, but First Aid, Doctor, Speech and Barter are substantially improved.

entries.text: You crave chems more easily.  Your chance to crave chems is twice normal, but you recover faster from their ill effects.
entries.source_text: You crave chems more easily.  Your chance to crave chems is twice normal, but you recover faster from their ill effects.

entries.text: Chems only affect you half as long as normal, but your chance to crave them is also only 50% of normal.
entries.source_text: Chems only affect you half as long as normal, but your chance to crave them is also only 50% of normal.

entries.text: As a night-time person, you are more awake when the sun goes down.  Your Intelligence and Perception are improved at night, but dulled during the day.
entries.source_text: As a night-time person, you are more awake when the sun goes down.  Your Intelligence and Perception are improved at night, but dulled during the day.

entries.text: Since you spent more time improving your skills than a normal person, you start with better skill levels.  The tradeoff is that you do not gain as many extra abilities.  You will gain a perk every four levels.
entries.source_text: Since you spent more time improving your skills than a normal person, you start with better skill levels.  The tradeoff is that you do not gain as many extra abilities.  You will gain a perk every four levels.

entries.text: You have more innate abilities than most, so you have not spent as much time honing your skills.  Your primary statistics are each +1, but you lose -10% on all skills to start, and receive 5 less skill points per level.
entries.source_text: You have more innate abilities than most, so you have not spent as much time honing your skills.  Your primary statistics are each +1, but you lose -10% on all skills to start, and receive 5 less skill points per level.
